shelters.name: New Hampshire SPCA
shelters.description: New Hampshire's oldest and largest animal shelter. Offers pet adoption, dog training, summer camps, cruelty intervention, low cost spay/neuter clinics, and humane education.

shelters.name: Humane Society for Greater Nashua
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 1900, celebrates 125 years. Offers Dog Transport Program, Seniors for Seniors program, Pet Food Pantry, and low-cost veterinary care.

shelters.name: Manchester Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Goal is zero-population growth through spay/neuter programs. Focuses on education, medical care, fostering, and adoption. Believes all animals deserve life, respect, and care.

shelters.name: Animal Rescue League of New Hampshire
shelters.description: Serves over 2,000 pets and their families each year. Voted Best Place to Volunteer two years in a row in Best of the 603.

shelters.name: New Hampshire Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit 501(c)(3) dedicated to finding loving homes for homeless pets and providing temporary shelter and care for lost dogs and cats.

shelters.name: Monadnock Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Monadnock region of southwest New Hampshire with adoption and animal welfare services.

shelters.name: Conway Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Mount Washington Valley and White Mountains region.

shelters.name: Upper Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Upper Valley region of New Hampshire and Vermont border area.

shelters.name: Lakes Region Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the Lakes Region of New Hampshire.

shelters.name: Sullivan County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Sullivan County in western New Hampshire.

shelters.name: Franklin Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving Franklin and central New Hampshire communities.

shelters.name: Above the Notch Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the North Country region of New Hampshire above the White Mountain notches.

shelters.name: Greater Derry Humane Society
shelters.description: Rescues animals and places them in permanent loving homes. All rescued animals kept in foster homes until placement - no physical shelter.

shelters.name: Hero Pups
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization based in Stratham, NH dedicated to finding homes for dogs in need.

shelters.name: Coos Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: Animal sanctuary serving the northernmost county in New Hampshire.

notes: Comprehensive collection of New Hampshire animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. NHSPCA is NH's oldest and largest shelter. Humane Society for Greater Nashua celebrates 125 years (founded 1900). Coverage spans Manchester, Nashua, Laconia, Bedford, Conway, the Lakes Region, Upper Valley, and North Country.
